name: 14906-solodecode-qwen3vl30ba3b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking, ungated, served in its native bf16 with no quantization_config.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 48 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, TEXT ONLY, single turn, no prefix buckets, seed 42. Fixed 512-token prompts and fixed 512-token generations (no stdev), temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so every request decodes exactly its 512 steps.
purpose: A reasoning assistant on one GPU answering a single user's 512-token prompts with 512-token replies.
launch:
# sglang launch declaration. Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested line is SKIPPED by
# the reader, so a re-flowed value never reaches the engine. host / port / served-model-name are
# set by whatever starts the server and must not be written here.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Thinking
tp-size: 1
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64
disable-radix-cache: true
context-length: 32768
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
